text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan was something else in the
Sprinters
Stakes last year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No kidding! She was still in her classic
year, but
she made the seniors look like
newbies!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
And now she's had a full year to get
stronger! I
can't wait to see what she's
got in store for us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the sheer number of hyped-up fans
here
today, it's as if what happened at
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen was just a
bad dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for Aston Machan herself...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to see something
special, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Yes, you'd like to see it?
Very well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da. It's a URA-certified Aston
Machan doll.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The project manager just delivered it to
me
personally. It was faster than sending
it by mail,
apparently.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No. I'm not looking for congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I certainly didn't expect that reaction. I
have no
idea what kind of response she's
looking for, so I
start throwing out my
impressions off the top of
my head.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's cute. But that's not what I
want to
hear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Are you looking at it the same
way I
am?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Like, the way you would if I drew a really
good
pic—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ding ding ding. That's right. I'm very,
very happy
right now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I could just melt.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And with that said, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hands me the mascot doll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is her very first official doll. I hope
she won't
regret giving it away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I promised, remember? I said I'd give
you the very
first one.
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for me to take this?
Is it really okay for me to take this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I want to buy my own Machan
doll. So,
you're welcome to have this
one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hold up the doll. Maybe it's just me,
but I think
there's a little more heft to it
than even the 3.0
prototype.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't let yourself get too
distracted by it,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Today's race is veeery special as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Watch every moment, burn each one
into your
memory, and lock them away
deep in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Because this time I have a request to
fulfill.
choice_data_list: You're more fired up than usual.
You're more fired up than usual, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Someone wanted to see the most
dazzling
Machan there is, as I recall.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And if that's what they want, I guess I'll
just have
to give it to them. That's how it
is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Anyway, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan runs off, wearing her
usual smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers envelop Nakayama Racecourse,
where a
second legend is about to
begin.
